30s Straight bar stretch
30s Banded Pull Aparts
30s 90/90 DB external rotation
30s Light DB shoulder press

2. Bench Press
Rounds: 3
12-12-12 reps

3. Cable Rope Face Pulls
Rounds: 3
12-12-12 reps

4. EZ-Bar Skull Crushers
Rounds: 3
10-10-10 reps

5. Cable Curls
Rounds: 3
15-15-15 reps

6. Easy Row
5 min

7. CIRCUIT
Stretch sore areas of body
Rounds: 5m
2m Worlds Greatest Stretch
2m Straight bar stretch

The card has no workout name, so I need a first line in double quotes. The card gives none, so I'll avoid inventing one and use a plain descriptive label... but that adds words, not numbers, which is acceptable.

Circuit 1: "Rounds: 2" means every lift takes 2 sets, each with its own time. Times go on * notes. Lifts with no rep count get "N sets" with N = 2.

Circuit 7: Rounds: 5m is a time, so it goes on a note. No set count is given, so the count is left out.

"Easy Row 5 min" has no rep count and no set count, so the lift is written bare, with the time on a note.

The card's first circuit is the first lift, so the warm-up line should say something. I'll write the warm-up line using the card's words "Warm up muscle group".

"Workout"
Warm up: Warm up muscle group
1. a. Straight Bar Stretch 2 sets
* 30s
super set b. Banded Pull Aparts 2 sets
* 30s
super set c. 90/90 DB External Rotation 2 sets
* 30s
super set d. Light DB Shoulder Press 2 sets
* 30s
2. Bench Press 3 sets of 12 reps
3. Cable Rope Face Pulls 3 sets of 12 reps
4. EZ-Bar Skull Crushers 3 sets of 10 reps
5. Cable Curls 3 sets of 15 reps
6. Easy Row
* 5 min
7. a. Worlds Greatest Stretch
* 2m. Rounds: 5m. Stretch sore areas of body
super set b. Straight Bar Stretch
* 2m
